[Section] Textual Embedding Learning
[source_id=20] We adopt a bi-directional LSTM model to generate textual embeddings for document quality assessment, following the method of BIBREF12 (“biLSTM” hereafter). The input to biLSTM is a textual document, and the output is a textual embedding, which will later integrate with the visual embedding.
[source_id=21] For biLSTM, each word is represented as a word embedding BIBREF37 , and an average-pooling layer is applied to the word embeddings to obtain the sentence embedding, which is fed into a bi-directional LSTM to generate the document embedding from the sentence embeddings. Then a max-pooling layer is applied to select the most salient features from the component sentences.
